mira: Quick heads-up — ran continuous-scheduler sweep across us-west1 (A100) and ap-southeast1 (H100). Dropping initial notes + raw numbers + config. Need ops + runtime folks to eyeball fairness regressions. :eyes:

mira: TL;DR: with window_ms=30 and max_batch_tokens=4096 we hit target throughput on H100 but p95 latency up ~12% in APAC, and fairness skew metric went from 0.08 -> 0.21 for small-tenant cohort.

jamal: Can you paste the perf table?

mira: Here — small table:
```
region    gpu   window_ms  max_tokens  qtype  p50(ms)  p95(ms)  tps
us-west1  A100  20         4096        fp16   45       120      180
ap-sout1  H100  30         4096        fp16   50       135      210
ap-sout1  H100  10         2048        int8   40       110      170``` 

alex: Interesting that int8 at lower max_tokens lowers p95 — did you run kernel sweep? which kernels used on H100?

mira: Kernel sweep used cuBLAS-optimized GEMM for fp16 and Triton/FlashAttn variants for int8 where available. On H100 flash-attn-v2 gave best latency on medium sequence lengths.

kai: For fairness skew — were you using priority decay? small tenants might be starved if max_batch_tokens is high.

mira: Yes priority_decay=0.6 in that run. When I lowered max_batch_tokens to 2048 and window_ms to 10, skew dropped to 0.09 but throughput dipped ~18% on H100.

jamal: Could try adaptive-window: start at 10ms, expand to 40ms if qps drops. Also consider KV-prefetch cache warmup for hot prefixes.

alex: Also test mixed quant profiles: keep embedding & FFN in fp16, attention in int8. That often hits a sweet spot for latency without hurting quality.

mira: Agreed. Next steps I'm going to:
- run adaptive-window experiment (10->40ms) in APAC H100 pool
- run mixed-quant kernels (attn=int8, rest=fp16)
- add a cohort-weighted fairness metric to the dashboard
I'll post results tomorrow. cc @ci-bot for scheduled jobs :calendar:

ci-bot: scheduled: contsched-apac-h100-adaptive-2076543210 (ETA 12h)

sre-bot: FYI we have spare capacity on A100 pool tonight if you want a cross-run.

mira: thanks all — will spin up A100 cross-run and tag results in this thread. :thumbsup:
